title: windows: update MS SDK versions in comments
body:
To make them more accurate.

Also:
- show Visual Studio version, where missing.
- ease the formatting.
- schannel_int.h: clang-tidy fallback code.

Used: `rg -l --sort=path CERT_FIND_HAS_PRIVATE_KEY`

---

https://github.com/curl/curl/pull/21621/files?w=1

Searched in this set of SDKs:

winsdk-07.1A-vs2012
